description: This PHP source file defines the ExpressionParser class for Twig, a templating engine. It handles parsing expressions, including unary, binary, function calls, array/mapping constructions, and operator precedence, facilitating the conversion of token streams into abstract syntax trees for template processing.

classes.name: Twig\ExpressionParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing Twig template expressions into an abstract syntax tree using precedence climbing algorithm.

methods.name: parseExpression
methods.description: Parses an expression respecting operator precedence, handling binary, unary, and arrow functions.

methods.name: getPrimary
methods.description: Retrieves the primary expression based on the current token, including literals, variables, or grouped expressions.

methods.name: parseConditionalExpression
methods.description: Parses ternary conditional expressions of the form 'condition ? expr1 : expr2'.

methods.name: parseArrow
methods.description: Parses arrow functions with syntax like '() => expression' or '() => { }'.

methods.name: parseStringExpression
methods.description: Parses string expressions, including concatenation and interpolation.

methods.name: parseSequenceExpression
methods.description: Parses array sequence expressions enclosed in square brackets.

methods.name: parseMappingExpression
methods.description: Parses mapping expressions enclosed in curly braces.

methods.name: parsePostfixExpression
methods.description: Handles postfix operators such as attribute access, subscripts, and filters.

methods.name: getFunctionNode
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs function nodes, including handling imported symbols and parser callables.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpression
methods.description: Parses subscript expressions, including array slices and method calls.

methods.name: parseFilterExpression
methods.description: Parses filter expressions chained with the '|' operator.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Parses argument list for function calls or macros.

methods.name: parseAssignmentExpression
methods.description: Parses assignment targets.

methods.name: parseMultitargetExpression
methods.description: Parses multiple expressions as targets, e.g., in destructuring assignments.

methods.name: checkConstantExpression
methods.description: Checks if a node contains only constant expressions.

methods.name: setDeprecationCheck
methods.description: Enables or disables deprecation checks during parsing.

methods.name: createArguments
methods.description: Creates an ArrayExpression object populated with parsed arguments.

methods.name: parseOnlyArguments
methods.description: Parses a list of arguments enclosed in parentheses.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpressionDot
methods.description: Parses attribute or method call subscripts.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpressionArray
methods.description: Parses array index or slice subscripts.
